newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash Jan wheat up on good volume.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash Jan wheat up on good volume.

text.p: Strong export demand pushed up Argentine January cash wheat prices in good volume on the Buenos Aires Cereals exchange, dealers said.
But the arrival of wheat from Entre Rios province faced delays because of the closure of the Zarate-Brazo Largo bridge which links the province to Buenos Aires.
Cash maize trade was quiet, awaiting foreign buyers, and soybean trade calmed after recent interest. But sunflower was firm on demand from crushers.
